svg.desc: 18 production and operation requirements of WP-S-06 §3. TSR-801 (B‡, waiting on an input). TSR-802 (B‡, blocked by a design gap). TSR-803 (B‡, procedure defined). TSR-804 (B‡, procedure defined). TSR-805 (B, waiting on an input). TSR-806 (QM (B-sup), backed by the design). TSR-807 (QM (SOTIF), waiting on an input). TSR-815 (B‡, waiting on an input). TSR-816 (B‡, waiting on an input). TSR-811 (QM (B-sup), backed by the design). TSR-812 (QM (B-sup), procedure defined). TSR-813 (QM, waiting on an input). TSR-808 (B‡, waiting on an input). TSR-809 (B, procedure defined). TSR-817 (B‡, procedure defined). TSR-810 (B‡, procedure defined). TSR-814 (B (stock path); CS (data), waiting on an input). TSR-818 (QM, procedure defined). Design measures of §4: TSR-514 (version shows build type): not met. TSR-512: implemented. TSR-506, TSR-515: not met. WP-O-01 OI-5 script: not met. SYS-141; AIR-23: partial. TSR-629 (DQ-056 A, DQ-132 A): implemented.
svg.text: Figure 3-1 · Production and operation over the life of an installed item
The 18 requirements of §3 by phase, each with what it protects, the procedure steps that carry it and where it stands: 7 defined, 8 waiting on an input, 1 blocked, 2 backed by the design
Only a released LionDriver baseline shall be installed: the installed openpilot
commit, AGNOS version and model artefact hashes shall equal the release record,
and the build shall not be dirty.
carried by: INS-15, INS-16, INS-18; SPC-04
The panda firmware shall be the release-signed, non-debug build recorded in the
release record; its version string and signature shall be compared before first
Every vehicle ECU firmware version (engine, EPS, ABS, radar, camera) shall equal
the reference record before engagement; a mismatch shall put the item in dashcam
mode until an impact analysis extends the scope.
The installed configuration shall show fingerprint TOYOTA_COROLLA_TSS2
(exact, not fuzzy), safety model toyota, safety parameter 73, alternative experience
0, openpilot longitudinal on, both in carParams and in pandaStates.
carried by: INS-22, INS-23, INS-24; SPC-06
Harness seating and the relay intercept/PCS-forwarding function shall be verified
at installation: no relay malfunction or CAN errors, intercepted messages absent on
the car side, PCS-relevant camera messages present on the car side with LD-SDA
carried by: INS-11, INS-13, INS-14, INS-27; SPC-01, SPC-02
The parameter set shall equal the release record: Experimental Mode per D-08,
DisengageOnAccelerator per WP-C-08, debug/maneuver/joystick modes absent, DM
The device shall be mounted within the position tolerance and calibrated within the
angle tolerance band derived from the model validation range.
carried by: INS-09, INS-10, INS-25, INS-26; SPC-03
Only devices and harnesses of the approved hardware revision, with clean history,
shall be installed; units returned after a field event or decommissioned from another
vehicle shall pass refurbishment inspection first.
Installation shall be done by a trained installer, and the installation record
(R-DEV…R-USR) shall be complete and second-person checked before the first
Before every drive the driver shall perform the pre-drive checks and shall not
engage if a check fails (vehicle warning lamps, VSC on, clean camera area, device
seated, DM camera unobstructed, no offroad alert, driver fit).
Each driver shall receive the user information and safety warnings before first use
and acknowledge them; in the development phase only approved safety drivers shall
carried by: WP-O-03 Part A/B; INS-30
Field monitoring shall collect and analyse drive logs and driver reports of every
installed item, including every disengagement caused by a safety mechanism
(controlsMismatch, relayMalfunction, RX invalid, heartbeat lost, safetyTxBlocked >
0), and feed problem resolution and the safety case.
carried by: OPS-11, OPS-12; WP-O-04; WP-P-03
Vehicle service actions that can invalidate an AoU or the calibration
(alignment/steering/suspension, EPS or ECM/ABS replacement or reflash,
windscreen, camera or radar work, tyre size, brake repair, collision repair, battery
disconnection, scan-tool sessions, aftermarket accessories) shall trigger the…
(INS-27) and harness inspection shall be repeated at least every 6 months and
after any service trigger; harness and camera windows inspected monthly.
protects: SG-07; AOU-09; latent faults of TSR-506
Item faults shall be handled by replacement, not repair: defective devices or
harnesses shall be quarantined, reported and returned; after replacement the full
provisioning and configuration steps shall be repeated.
Only released baselines shall be installed by update; until signed updates exist,
automatic updates shall be disabled and updates installed manually, followed by
INS-15…INS-23; model-weight changes require SOTIF re-evaluation; envelope
changes require the envelope verification evidence; parameters shall be re-checked…
On removal of the item the stock camera connection shall be restored and stock
TSS functions (LTA/LDA, DRCC, PCS) and the absence of DTCs verified; logs
needed for field monitoring retrieved; device data, credentials and identity keys
wiped or the device kept under LionDriver control with its history recorded.
At end of support of a release, every user shall be informed with the date after
which the release must not be engaged.
4 Design measures that turn a manual check into a system measure
Firmware build type and identity readable for INS-17
TSR-514 (version shows build type) · Not met (GAP-25)
Safety mode/param fixed in firmware so INS-22/23 become a confirmation, not the only control
TSR-512 · Implemented in the reference build (panda 3859fa8), not verified on hardware; other
Relay checked at every power-up so PM-03 is not the latent-fault interval
Configuration extraction from the installation log
Logs identify software, firmware and model versions
EPS and ABS/VSC fault codes read by the item, so the OPS-01 lamp check is no longer the only barrier for those
TSR-629 (DQ-056 A, DQ-132 A) · Implemented in host software; not verified on the vehicle
The status is read from each requirement's Status cell (STATUS_OF quotes the phrase).
Generated by fig_s06_lifecycle.py from WP-S-06 §3 and §4. "Production" is installation and provisioning of a bought device (tailoring T-07); the procedures are in WP-O-01 to WP-O-05.

g.text: Terms: ABS anti-lock braking system; on the Toyota, the ABS/VSC ECU that also runs stability control · AGNOS the comma device's operating system · AIR-nn AI safety requirement (WP-C-11 §6) · AoU assumption of use:

what the analysis assumes about the car, the driver or the environment · AOU-nn assumption of use (WP-C-01 §7); an R suffix marks the FSC's refined version · CAN controller area network: the vehicle's data bus ·

CS-nn cybersecurity architecture decision CS-AD-nn (WP-S-07 §3.4) · D-nn design decision of the earlier decision list (D-01…D-12; D-08 is the Experimental Mode decision) · DEC-nn decommissioning step (WP-O-02 §7) ·

DM driver monitoring · DQ-nn decision of the project lead (decision register) · DRCC dynamic radar cruise control: Toyota's stock adaptive cruise · DTC diagnostic trouble code: a fault code an ECU stores, read with

a scan tool or over UDS · ECM engine control module · ECU electronic control unit · EPS electric power steering · FSR-nn functional safety requirement (FSC) · GAP-nn gap found by the gap assessment · INS-nn

installation check (WP-O-01) · ISO International Organization for Standardization · ITS-nn item service step: replacing a faulty device or harness (WP-O-02 §5) · LD-SDA LionDriver Supervised Driving Assistance, the

item · LDA lane departure alert: Toyota's stock lane warning · LTA lane tracing assist: Toyota's stock lane-centring function · OI-nn open item of the document it appears in · OPS-nn operation step: the driver's

pre-drive and field checks (WP-O-02 §3) · PCS pre-collision system: Toyota's stock collision warning and braking · PM-nn periodic maintenance check of the item (WP-O-02 §4) · QM quality managed: no ASIL; ordinary

quality processes suffice · R-DEV installation record block: device and harness (WP-O-01 §5) · R-USR installation record block: driver briefing (WP-O-01 §5) · RX receive · SAE SAE International (formerly the Society

of Automotive Engineers) · SG-nn safety goal (HARA §6) · SOTIF safety of the intended functionality (ISO 21448): hazards with nothing failing · SPC-nn special characteristic of the installation (WP-O-01 §4) · SSH

secure shell (remote login) · SVC-nn vehicle service action that needs a re-check of the item (WP-O-02 §4) · SYS system requirement SYS-nnn of WP-S-01 · T-nn code-derived detection or reaction time (WP-S-04 §4); in

WP-M-01 and WP-S-06, a tailoring decision T-01…T-08 (WP-M-01 §5) · TSR-nn technical safety requirement (WP-S-02) · TSS Toyota Safety Sense (TSS 2.0: the car's stock lane assist, radar cruise and pre-collision

package) · UPD-nn update procedure step (WP-O-02) · VSC vehicle stability control (Toyota's stability system) · WP-nn work product, e.g. WP-C-04; the letter is its area (M management, C concept, S system, H
hardware, W software, V validation, P processes, A analyses, O operation, K safety case)
